SELECT sbd.id, sbdd.id AS detailId, sbd.code, pd.sku_id, pd.sku_no, sbdd.warehouse_id, pd.warehouse_location, pd.qty as pickingQty FROM so_b2c_delivery sbd INNER JOIN so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd ON sbdd.main_id = sbd.id AND sbdd.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN picking_detail pd ON pd.source_detail_id = sbdd.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE where sbd.id in
#{id}

SELECT sbd.status AS tabFlag, count(distinct sbd.id) AS count FROM so_b2c_delivery sbd LEFT JOIN so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd ON sbd.id = sbdd.main_id AND sbdd.is_deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN erp_oms.so_b2c_label fsbl ON sbd.source_id = fsbl.main_id AND fsbl.is_deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN foreign_so_b2c_label fsbl ON sbd.source_id = fsbl.main_id AND fsbl.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE sbd.is_deleted=FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM so_b2c_delivery_intercept sbdi WHERE sbdi.delivery_id = sbd.id AND sbdi.handle_status = 'waitHandle' AND sbdi.is_deleted = FALSE)
${params.permissionSql}
GROUP BY sbd.status

select count(distinct sbd.id) from so_b2c_delivery sbd LEFT JOIN so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd ON sbd.id = sbdd.main_id AND sbd.is_deleted = FALSE where sbd.is_deleted=FALSE and sbd.shipment_mark = 'manual'
${params.permissionSql}

-- b2c发货单冻结 select sbdd.sku_id, sbdd.sku_no, sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id, sbdd.warehouse_id, 'soB2cDelivery' as source_type, sbd.id as source_id, sbd.code as source_code, sbdd.id as source_detail_id, sbd.create_time as bill_date, sbd.create_time as trade_time, sbdd.delivery_qty as qty, 'so_b2c_delivery' as businessType from so_b2c_delivery sbd inner join so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd on sbd.id = sbdd.main_id and sbdd.is_deleted = false and sbdd.delivery_qty > 0 and sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id != '' where sbd.is_deleted = false union all --b2c发货单取消冻结 select sbdd.sku_id, sbdd.sku_no, sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id, sbdd.warehouse_id, 'soB2cDelivery' as source_type, sbd.id as source_id, sbd.code as source_code, sbdd.id as source_detail_id, sbd.update_time as bill_date, sbd.update_time as trade_time, sbdd.delivery_qty as qty, 'so_b2c_delivery_cancel' as businessType from so_b2c_delivery sbd inner join so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd on sbd.id = sbdd.main_id and sbdd.is_deleted = false and sbdd.delivery_qty > 0 and sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sbd.status = 'cancelDelivery' where sbd.is_deleted = false union all --直接调拨单出库 select tid.sku_id, tid.sku_no, sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id, sbdd.warehouse_id, 'transferInfo' as source_type, ti.id as source_id, ti.code as source_code, tid.id as source_detail_id, ti.approve_time as bill_date, ti.approve_time as trade_time, tid.qty as qty, '' as businessType from transfer_info ti inner join transfer_info_detail tid on ti.id = tid.main_id and tid.is_deleted = false and ti.approve_status = 'approve' and tid.qty > 0 inner join picking_detail pd on tid.source_detail_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd on sbdd.id = pd.source_detail_id and sbdd.is_deleted = false and sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sbdd.warehouse_id = tid.out_warehouse_id where ti.is_deleted = false union all --销售出库单出库(非旺店通) select sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id, sbdd.warehouse_id, 'soOutstock' as source_type, so.id as source_id, so.code as source_code, sod.id as source_detail_id, so.approve_time as bill_date, so.approve_time as trade_time, sod.actual_qty as qty, 'so_out_stock' as businessType from so_outstock so inner join so_outstock_detail sod on so.id = sod.main_id and sod.is_deleted = false and sod.actual_qty > 0 and so.approve_status = 'approve' and so.source_type = 'soB2cDelivery' and so.order_type ='B2C' and sod.virtual_warehouse_id != '' inner join so_b2c_delivery_detail sbdd on sbdd.id = sod.source_detail_id and sbdd.is_deleted = false and sbdd.virtual_warehouse_id != '' and sbdd.warehouse_id = so.warehouse_id where so.is_deleted = false union all --旺店通来源销售出库单出库 select sod.sku_id, sod.sku_no, sod.virtual_warehouse_id, sod.warehouse_id, 'soOutstock' as source_type, so.id as source_id, so.code as source_code, sod.id as source_detail_id, so.approve_time as bill_date, so.approve_time as trade_time, sod.actual_qty as qty, 'out_usable' as businessType from so_outstock so inner join so_outstock_detail sod on so.id = sod.main_id and sod.is_deleted = false and sod.actual_qty > 0 and so.approve_status = 'approve' and so.source_type != 'soB2cDelivery' and so.order_type ='B2C' and sod.virtual_warehouse_id != '' where so.is_deleted = false
